items.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and I’m here at the Hotel Utica with vibist Peter Appleyard. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Thanks, Monk.

ctx.x: Peter was interviewed in Utica, NY, on October 4, 2012, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m here at the Hotel Utica with vibist Peter Appleyard. Welcome to Utica.
Thanks, Monk. Before we go any further, how did you get the name Monk?
